content: Sharbati wheat in Sehore & Bhopal mandi trades at ₹2,150/qtl gross. Local APMC commission is 6% to 8% plus toll costs. Keemat direct bidding delivers ₹2,380/qtl gross with only 0.75% platform fee, producing an average net premium of ₹17,060 for a 100-quintal lot.

AGMARKNET Grade A wheat requires moisture below 12.5%, foreign matter below 2.0%, hectolitre weight > 76 kg/hL, and grain uniformity > 80%. Moisture above 14% requires shade drying for 24-48 hours before auction publishing.

Buyer deposits 100% of lot value into NBFC regulated escrow before dispatch. Funds are locked instantly upon auction acceptance. Release occurs within 4 hours of digital delivery sign-off with zero payment default guarantee.

Farmers dissatisfied with AI quality grading can lodge an APMC certified lab dispute via the platform. Certified APMC sample re-grading SLA is 18 to 24 hours. Escrow remains protected during disputes.
